title: Iran turns to Putin as war, US election reshape strategic calculations
gist: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei made an unannounced Moscow visit to meet Putin, carrying a message from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, as Tehran resists US demands to reopen the Strait of Hormuz; the piece frames it as Iran turning vulnerability into leverage while questioning whether Russia will actually become a security partner (text is truncated).

insights.claim: Iran's Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei made an unannounced visit to Moscow and met Russian President Vladimir Putin, with the Kremlin's foreign policy aide and the head of Russia's military intelligence agency attending.
insights.speaker: A correspondent in Tehran
insights.so_what: Presence of Russian military intelligence chief hints at security/arms cooperation, not just diplomacy.
